user_query: I want to surprise my brother with a birthday gift, but I'm not sure which coin he collects. Can you fetch a collection of all coins available? Also, I'd like to convert the currency of the gift price to his local currency using the CurrencyAPI.net.

TaskList.description: Fetch a collection of all available coins to identify which ones my brother collects.
Convert the gift price from the original currency to my brother's local currency using the CurrencyAPI.net.
